title: Building Web3 Apps Was Hard. Now It's Easy.
summary: Build web3 apps with no code or familiar frameworks. Use pre-packaged smart contracts and APIs to add web3 functionality to any web2 app.
author: Nathaniel Thoreson
body:
Web3 may be the next generation of the internet, but that doesn't make it easy for users or builders. Building web3 apps requires learning new and niche programming languages, frameworks, and tools, like Solidity, Truffle, Metamask, and Web3.js.

You're not an economist (probably) but building crypto-powered projects can get you dangerously close to the world of an economist. As a builder in web3, you'll frequently run into complex problems like gas fees, tokenomics, and yields.

To make it all worse, once you build the product, you have to attract users. This is harder than it sounds. It can be challenging to onboard new users who may be interacting with web3 first time. They might not even have or want a crypto wallet.

Having deep technical expertise shouldn't keep builders or potential users away from the space. Instead, we should build inclusive technology that empowers builders and the users of the products they build.

That's where DropChain comes in. DropChain is a web3 engine that powers any web2 app. It allows you to build web3 apps using no code or with programming frameworks, you already know. Anything that accepts Restful APIs will do. You don't need to learn solidity or deal with blockchain-specific issues. You can focus on building a great app and let DropChain do the heavy lifting.

The DropChain API is a robust and growing library of audited and pre-packaged smart contracts that you can plug into any app via POST requests and JSON payloads. You can use these smart contracts to enhance your app with web3 functionality, such as creating, sending, and swapping NFTs and tokens, fetching wallet addresses and transaction notes, freezing and deleting assets, and more.

The future is multi-chain. That's why DropChain supports all the most used blockchains so you can build and grow your community anywhere. Our favorites are Algorand, Ethereum, Avalanche, Polygon, Optimism, and Arbitrum. DropChain is chain agnostic and handles all the cross-chain communication for you.

What good is a web3 app if no one uses it? The DropChain Single Sign On (SSO) enables seamless onboarding for your users. This feature allows users to sign into all their web3 DropChain apps with a single click, just like Google sign-in. Users don't need a crypto wallet or install a sketchy browser extension. They can use their web2 credentials to access your web3 app.
